summary: Medicure Inc. filed a Form 6-K with unaudited condensed consolidated interim financial statements for the three and six months ended June 30, 2026, including MD&A and CEO/CFO certifications. The filing reports routine financial results: net loss of $1.4 million in Q2 2026 versus $0.8 million in Q2 2025, with revenue increasing to $7.4 million. No special-situation event such as acquisition, tender offer, or restructuring is disclosed; the document is a standard quarterly report for a foreign private issuer. No deal terms, transactions, or board actions requiring special-situations classification are present.
